connector.name: Huly MCP by dearlordylord
connector.registryDescription: Huly MCP: feature-complete MCP server for Huly integration
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package huly-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dearlordylord account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HULY_URL
env.description: Reachable self-hosted or replacement hosted Huly API URL

env.name: HULY_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
env.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Omit to use the package default.

env.name: HULY_TOOL_MODE
env.description: Tool exposure mode: auto (default), native, or proxy. Auto keeps exact claude-code native and resolves Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, opencode, Claude AI, and unknown clients to proxy mode.

env.name: PROXY_OUTPUT_STRICT
env.description: Set true to make active TOOLSETS / TOOLS a hard allow-list for proxy search, schema lookup, and invocation. Defaults to false.

env.name: TOOLSETS
env.description: Comma-separated native Huly tool categories to expose, such as issues,projects,search. If unset with TOOLS, all native tools are exposed.

env.name: TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated exact native Huly tool names to expose in addition to selected TOOLSETS, such as list_documents,create_issue.
